other_conditions: Must be regularly admitted to colleges or equivalent institutions.
Must not be residing in any government hostel.
Must be admitted before the last date and submit Appendix-B.
Must be within the income limit of the Post Metric Scholarship Scheme.
Must be responsible for any excess rent beyond the prescribed allowance.
Ineligible for the scheme if the student fails in any year.
Must be aware of the third-party evaluation and annual review of the scheme.
benefits_summary: Provides a house rent allowance of ₹2,000 per month in Bhopal, Indore, Jabalpur, Gwalior and Ujjain; ₹1,250 at district headquarters; and ₹1,000 in tehsil/development block headquarters and other cities.
